blind_read: The mechanism in the monkey's hands split in two. The monkey looked up in alarm and held the pieces under a red cross.

evidence.observation: The round, toothed part sits between both hands. Cyan pixels at (13,25) and (13,26) make a short stripe down the brown tail, visible against the cream ground.
A gap opens between the toothed halves, each held in a fist. The enlarged eyes turn up toward the X after the break. The white cross and warm hands remain distinct in both coat colors.

blockers: Cyan flecks move through the tail and face as the gear comes apart. These read as colored edge noise on the brown sprite.
